description: The same product tracked at different stores on Monity Network ("available at 2 of 3 stores", cheapest): each store's tracker, its latest value and availability. Only stores confirmed by a product code or by the trackers' owners. Give the product id from a change record's thing.id (query_network_records) or the slug of any of its trackers. Not found when fewer than two stores are public.

ref.description: A change record's thing.id, or a tracker's slug or id

name: get_network_product
title: Get a product at every store
